approval.note: yerel test: ifade çekim/biçim farkı (transcript'te çekimli geçiyor), yanlış pozitif

segments.text: Imagine being offered a role in a film that later becomes a huge hit and turning it down.
segments.englishExplanation: Imagine refusing a film role that later becomes a massive commercial hit.
segments.turkishExplanation: Sonradan büyük bir başarı yakalayan bir filmdeki rolü teklif alıp reddettiğinizi hayal edin.

segments.text: Actors do it more often than you think.
segments.englishExplanation: Famous actors reject popular film roles more frequently than expected.
segments.turkishExplanation: Oyuncular bunu düşündüğünüzden çok daha sık yapıyor.

segments.text: Picture an actress who reads a script so violent that she can't sleep that night.
segments.englishExplanation: Picture an actress reading a script so terrifyingly violent that she cannot sleep.
segments.turkishExplanation: O gece uyumasını engelleyecek kadar şiddet dolu bir senaryo okuyan bir aktrisi hayal edin.

segments.text: It's such a hard decision that she calls her agent in tears.
segments.englishExplanation: Making this decision is so painful that she cries while calling her agent.
segments.turkishExplanation: O kadar zor bir karar ki menajerini gözyaşları içinde arıyor.

segments.text: She turns the role down anyway.
segments.englishExplanation: Despite the potential fame, she declines the offer anyway.

segments.text: Years later, she comes across the film on television,
segments.englishExplanation: Many years later, she unexpectedly sees the movie playing on TV.
segments.turkishExplanation: Yıllar sonra televizyonda o filme denk geliyor,

segments.text: now famous and full of awards. Is she sorry? Not really.
segments.englishExplanation: The movie is now extremely famous and award-winning, yet she has no regrets.
segments.turkishExplanation: film artık ünlü ve ödüllerle dolu. Pişman mı? Pek sayılmaz.

segments.text: Some roles are such a bad fit that no amount of success would make them feel right.
segments.englishExplanation: Some roles simply do not feel right for an actor, regardless of how successful the movie becomes.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bazı roller kişiye o kadar uymaz ki hiçbir başarı onları doğru hissettirmeye yetmez.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To 'turn down' means to refuse or reject an offer or invitation.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: 'Turn down' ifadesi, bir teklifi veya öneriyi reddetmek anlamına gelir.
learningPoints.exampleEn: She turned down the offer because she wanted to live closer to her family.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Ailesine daha yakın yaşamak istediği için teklifi reddetti.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To 'come across' means to find or see something or someone by chance.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: 'Come across' fiili, bir şeye veya birine tesadüfen rastlamak ya da denk gelmek demektir.
learningPoints.exampleEn: I came across an old diary while clearing out the attic.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Tavan arasını temizlerken eski bir günlüğe denk geldim.

quiz.question: In segment 6, what does the phrasal verb 'comes across' mean when the actress sees the film on television?

options.text: Finds or stumbles upon something by chance
Searches for something intentionally on TV
Critiques or reviews a movie professionally

issues.message: Learning point ifadesi ("turn down") segment 5'in transcript metninde literal olarak bulunamadı — pedagojik notation/çekim farkı olabilir, yanlış pozitif olasılığı var.
